📋 Tagging Strategy & Roadmap

🎙️ Nathan's Core Expectations

Sourced directly from the client briefing transcript:

  • 100% Searchable & Filterable: Clean tagging so customers can easily find, search, and identify every part we make.
  • Focus Platforms: Prioritize Toyota Supra (A80/A90) and Mazda RX-7 (FD3S) as top sellers.
  • Nuances & Search Gaps: Fix "minor, small nuances" where products are not searchable or mis-tagged.
  • Consistency Warning: Incorrect tagging or wrong pricing creates massive problems long-term.
📚 PDF Tagging Standard Rules

Approved classification rules from standard reference:

  • 3-Tier Data Architecture:
    • Product Type: Native Shopify category field (Must be 1 of 14 controlled types).
    • shop_by_part: Metafield for sidebar filters (JSON array of strings, e.g., ["Exterior Parts"]).
    • included_components: Metafield listing kit elements (JSON array of strings, e.g., ["Front Bumper", "Side Skirt"]).
🔑 Supra & RX-7 Gold Standard Patterns

Key observations from correctly configured models:

  • ⚠️ STRICT PROTECTION RULE: We will strictly NOT touch or modify any of the already-correctly-configured Supra & RX-7 products (the 118 verified gold-standard models). They are completely read-only and used purely as a reference model to copy settings for other cars.
  • Array Serialization: Metafields on Shopify must be written as stringified JSON arrays (e.g. ["Bumpers"]) rather than plain text strings to integrate with the liquid storefront logic.
  • Type Normalization: Legacy product types (like Spoiler, Front Lip, Trunk) break category logic. Standardizing them to Spoiler & Wing, Lip & Splitter, Trunk & Hatch instantly places them into correct collections.
🚀 Implementation Process & Roadmap

The 6-Step workflow to normalize all 1,324 products:

  1. Step 1: Backup & Snapshot: Save state of all products, types, and metafields to a local JSON backup (Completed).
  2. Step 2: Rename Product Types: Run automated API patches to map retired types to correct controlled types. Bypasses all correct Supra/RX-7 reference models.
